gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Spacious and commanding: Goldman gives every letter plenty of room. Noto Sans Buhid keeps its curve ends well away from the stems, giving the pair modern clarity beside the swagger.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Widely set letters give Goldman its swagger, with round forms like open parentheses. But Noto Sans Cherokee stays approachable, its tall band of letters and wide-gapped e softening that bold swagger.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Goldman is bold and wide, its rounds like open parentheses. Noto Sans Chorasmian sits below with curves that stop short and a large x-height, so the two sit together without crowding.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Goldman is bold and commanding, with widely set, generously spaced letters. Noto Sans Devanagari makes the paragraphs go down smoothly, its open-curved g and compact skyline blending capitals into lowercase.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Parenthesis-like rounds give Goldman a commanding stance, and its wide-set letters never crowd. Noto Sans Georgian then reads cleanly through long paragraphs, its open curves and short ascender stems keeping every line light.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Big, bold and wide: Goldman spaces its letters generously and rounds them like open parentheses. Noto Sans Kaithi fills the line with lowercase that rivals capitals, its e left open, a sturdy partner for that swagger.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Commanding at the top, Goldman spreads wide, generously spaced letters with rounds like open parentheses. Noto Sans Kharoshthi counters with approachable, unclosed curves and a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Swagger first: Goldman bends its rounds like open parentheses, wide and bold. Noto Sans Khojki takes over for the reading, with wide exits that let light through and a large, clear eye on every e.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Goldman makes an entrance: wide-set, bold, rounded like open parentheses. Goldman does the commanding; Noto Sans Khudawadi does the welcoming, with unlatched rounds and little height difference between capitals and lowercase.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-kr: Bold, wide-set Goldman rounds its letters like open parentheses. Noto Sans KR is clean and contemporary, its generous curve gaps and stubby ascenders making a sturdy counterweight to all that width.
